label: PLC 1x128 spliced
notes: Insertion loss 23.8 dB for a 1:128 spliced module (ideal split 10*log10(128) = 21.07 dB plus 2.73 dB excess). 23.8 dB is Precision OT's published 1x128 figure without connectors; the vendor band is wide at this ratio - DMS quotes <=24.0 dB standard grade, Browave 23.5 dB typical and Montclair 24.5 dB typical - so treat +/-1 dB as the real spread. Notes are datasheet typicals, not a limit: replace with the part actually purchased before construction. A 1:128 is the last single-chip ratio and usually the last doubling before a two-chip module.
